# CIS deterministic toolkit evidence

- Run template applicability before hand-writing repeated structures and record the exact decision.
- Changed source work requires exact routing and reconciled test run evidence; placeholders are not evidence.
- Policy roots declare governed `targets:`. Derived policy-impact reports cannot approve remediation.
- Diagnostics read only enabled, repository-relative, non-sensitive sources from `docs/references/diagnostics-profile.md`.
- Structured diagnostics remain bounded and redacted; fingerprints never replace raw test or runtime artifacts.
- Run strict tooling-evidence validation before handoff or final verification.
